name: Eyecare-Bench
description: Eyecare-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate large vision-language models on intelligent ophthalmic diagnosis tasks across multiple dimensions, focusing on fine-grained, region-specific ophthalmic lesion identification.
reputation: A specialized ophthalmology benchmark used in recent vision-language model evaluations, but still niche compared with broader medical imaging benchmarks.
notes: Includes a tailored dataset Eyecare-100K and addresses challenges in ophthalmic diagnosis with a multi-agent data engine and adaptive model design.
